title: Replay Pack metadata (rpk_schema_version 1.x)
description: Normative schema for the metadata object embedded in a .rpk safetensors __metadata__ header. See SPEC.md.

rpk_schema_version.description: Semantic version of the container schema. Minor bumps add optional fields.

id.description: Stable pack identifier; file basename SHOULD equal the last path segment.

diffusivity.description: Fixed free diffusivity (m^2/s). Not a knob.

boundary.description: Simulation-box boundary (SPEC §4.5): sets Field grid-map sampling (wrapped for periodic, clamped otherwise) and bounds the envelope (a finite box restricts long-diffusion-time replays). Default 'periodic'.

substrate_frame.description: Intrinsic orientation frame R, a 3x3 orthonormal right-handed matrix (SPEC §4.2). Columns are the canonical substrate basis in stored coordinates: column 3 (z) = primary axis (fibre), columns 1-2 = a fixed perpendicular basis (no free rotation about the fibre). A canonical direction maps to stored coordinates as R*d. Omit (or null) => identity: positions are already in the canonical frame. B0/gradient directions are defined relative to this frame.

cell_size.description: Field-map grid spacing (m); present iff Field grid maps (susc_field_{0,C,S}).

delta_chi_a.description: Anisotropic susceptibility scale the Field basis/maps are normalized to (SPEC §6.4); present iff Field tier. A purely isotropic source uses susc_field_0 / iso terms alone.

field_grid.description: Metadata for the per-walker Field basis susc_field_basis (SPEC §6.4.1); present iff that channel is used.

origin.description: World coordinate (m) of the field grid corner used to sample the basis.

components.description: Order of the 13 basis channels, e.g. ["iso_local","iso_P","aniso_G"].

refocus.description: How the susceptibility phase gate s(t_k) is applied at replay (SPEC §6.6).

per_comp.description: Per-compartment relaxation; index = compartment id (0 = extra/free). Required iff Bulk-relaxation tier.

R.description: Optional per-compartment 3x3 rotation(s) mapping the compartment's local frame to the lab frame, used to orient the anisotropic Field maps (SPEC §6.4). null if unoriented.

method.description: Codec name. 'identity' = raw. Walker-preserving codecs required alongside per-walker channels.

replay_envelope.description: Declared capability tiers and acquisition domain (SPEC §7/§11). A flagged tier MUST have its channels present. Flags use explicit self-describing names; readers SHOULD also accept the 1.x aliases T1T2/relaxation->bulk_relaxation, rho->surface_relaxivity, B0_any/orientation_any/field_offresonance/field_orientation->field, mt->magnetization_transfer.

gradient.description: T0: replays any gradient waveform, b-tensor, EAP. Always true.

bulk_relaxation.description: T1: replays any intrinsic per-compartment T2/T1 (distinct from surface_relaxivity).

surface_relaxivity.description: T2: replays any surface relaxivity rho.

field.description: C3: replays static off-resonance / susceptibility (any B0 and susceptibility scale), and orientation relative to B0. Carried by EITHER the shared l=2 grid maps susc_field_{0,C,S} (SPEC §6.4) OR the per-walker susc_field_basis channel (SPEC §6.4.1, arbitrary 3-D morphology, full main-field direction).

magnetization_transfer.description: C4: replays MT. Carried by EITHER the per-walker bound_fraction channel (emergent, vector-Bloch, SPEC §6.5) OR the parametric two-pool `mt` pool descriptor (mean-field, Bloch-McConnell Z-spectrum/MTR, SPEC §6.5.1).

diffusivity_fixed.description: Diffusivity is a fixed pack property, not a knob.

acquisition.description: Certified acquisition domain the producer stands behind.

B0_list.description: Field strengths (T) covered by the Field tier.

max_refocusing_pulses.description: Max refocusing-pulse density (CPMG echoes) the pack is certified for. Present whenever a codec that truncates a non-linearly consumed channel bounds the servable gate bandwidth (SPEC 9.4 rule 5) - notably the per-walker Field basis stored as K temporal modes (SPEC 6.4.1). A request above this is OUTSIDE the envelope and MUST be refused, not extrapolated; `fidelity` does not describe this limit.

field_modes.description: K, the number of temporal modes retained for susc_field_basis, from which max_refocusing_pulses derives (reference implementation: K >= 2*n_refocus). Informative - max_refocusing_pulses is the binding declaration.

fidelity.description: Required iff any lossy codec (SPEC §9). Codec-agnostic trust certificate: the decoded-vs-raw replay error, whatever codec produced it. Lives in the core metadata (not the registry) because it is read identically by any replayer or bank.

floor_max.description: Irreducible split-half MC noise floor for the same ensemble.

within_2x_floor.description: err_max <= 2*floor_max, i.e. the loss is below the MC noise (scientifically negligible).

battery.description: The acquisition set over which err_max/floor_max were measured.

mt.description: Parametric two-pool qMT pool descriptor (SPEC §6.5.1). Present iff C4 is declared in the mean-field (not per-walker bound_fraction) representation. Fixed-at-walk-time geometry/tissue properties, not knobs.

S_over_V.description: Myelin surface-to-free-volume ratio the pool was derived from (m^-1).

substrate.description: What was walked (descriptive only; the geometry format itself is out of scope, SPEC §1). Feeds the substrate-bank catalog card via provenance + the Croissant sidecar (SPEC §12).

ref.description: Optional URI / DOI / hash of the source substrate.

permeability.description: Fixed membrane permeability the walk used (m/s); not a replay knob in 1.x (SPEC §7).

license.description: License of the SOURCE substrate; never relicensed by this format.
